newsitem.title: USA: American Greetings sees yr EPS $2.20-$2.25.
newsitem.headline: American Greetings sees yr EPS $2.20-$2.25.

text.p: American Greetings Corp said Thursday it expects to report net income for the year between $2.20 and $2.25 per share.
Wall Street estimates placed the company's earnings at $2.25 for the year, according to First Call.
Earlier Thursday, the company reported third quarter earnings of $1 per share, above a First Call consensus estimate of $0.97.
The company said the results reflect shifting sales and income into the second half of the year as seasonal products are made and shipped closer to the time retailers need them.

"We anticipated this shift, and our third quarter results indicate that we are on track," the company said in a release. "We expect that this shifting will have a positive effect on our fourth quarter results as well."

The company's third quarter earnings in 1995 were $0.24 per share after a one-time $52 million write-down of its CreataCard assets. Earnings in the 1995 third quarter were $0.71 per share before the write-down.
